description: Capability for the shell webview (and, later, settings). Scoped by webview label, not window label, so it never reaches the `svc-<id>` service webviews that share the `main` window (design.md §4.3, §9.2; Tauri 2.11's `webviews` field applies regardless of a webview's window, unlike `windows`, which would grant every webview on that window).
